Kardaur

Overview

Kardaur is the Khadaganian lieutenant who presents the captured Zak to Aiset-Bek. He arranges the prisoner hunt in Death Canyon and threatens punishment even beyond death if Zak fails to entertain his superior. The Odalisque, whom he enslaves, helps Zak escape and points out that Kardaur will be guarding the gate. [1, 2, 3]

Captivity in Death Canyon

Zak is captured near the portal on Suslanger. Lieutenant Kardaur presents him to Aiset-Bek, who orders him used as live quarry for soldiers seeking promotion. Surviving the run through Death Canyon earns only a return to captivity, not freedom. Kardaur threatens punishment through necromancy if Zak dies too quickly and displeases his superior. [1, 4]

The Odalisque and the escape

The Odalisque approaches Zak after his ordeal. Enslaved by Kardaur and deprived even of a personal name, she wants his death and knows he will guard the gate that night. She steals the key to Zak’s cage. Her father, a rat hunter who disappeared in the caves, told her of the Wormheads’ temple and the bridges across its lava rivers. She uses that knowledge to explain a route the guards fear to follow. Zak kills Kardaur for the fortress key and escapes toward the cave; releasing the caged spiders can delay pursuit. The Odalisque and Zak part with wishes for each other’s freedom and survival, without a stated account of her later fate. [2, 3, 5, 6, 7]
